snippet.title: A Bold Move Defying All Known Laws of Time and Labor
snippet.description:
Example play through of WTF Is Happening, available now at https://www.airheadgames.com.

🗞️ About WTF Is Happening
Players are freelance reporters at a struggling newspaper, The Airhead Times. Each round, you'll get a theme and a random three-letter acronym to pitch the perfect headline to Poppy, the Editor-in-Chief.

You won't have much time to make journalistic magic before the deadline. The room votes on the headline with the most potential, and Poppy runs the story. Land the funniest, fastest headlines to earn points and rise through the ranks of the newsroom.

It's newsroom nonsense meets acronym anarchy. Good luck making sense of WTF Is Happening.

🎈 About Airhead Games
Airhead Games are quick, multiplayer party games that never play the same. Your dynamic host, Poppy, makes every game feel deeply personal by calling out players by name, riffing on answers, and weaving your group into the game. It's endless fun for your Twitch stream, team ice breaker, or friendly game night.
